spec.name: Neon Horizon — 1980s Arcade Cabinet
spec.description: A 1980s upright arcade cabinet in synthwave style: deep violet cabinet with sunset side stripes, a neon-trimmed control deck, a glowing CRT with a cyan grid and magenta sun, and a backlit marquee crown.
spec.layout: An upright arcade cabinet standing on the floor, facing +Z: the player stands at +Z and looks into the screen. It is a single tall slab 0.75 m wide, 1.78 m tall and 0.90 m deep, centred on x = 0, front face at z = +0.45, back at z = -0.45. From bottom to top: (1) a plinth/base body y 0-1.02 with a coin door and kick panel on the front face; (2) a control deck y 1.02-1.22, a slab that slopes down toward the player (high at its rear edge z = 0.18, low at its front lip z = 0.46) carrying two joysticks and button clusters; (3) a screen housing y 1.02-1.62 set back at z -0.45..0.24, with a dark CRT glass tilted back ~8 degrees, a chunky bezel and side cheeks; (4) a marquee lightbox y 1.60-1.80 that caps the top and juts slightly forward, backlit with a neon sun and horizon-grid logo; (5) a flat rear panel at z -0.40..-0.47 closing the back with vents and a power switch. Synthwave shows everywhere: the cabinet is deep indigo-violet, every edge wears thin neon trim (pink/cyan/purple) as separate small parts, the sides carry horizontal sunset bands (orange over red over magenta), the screen glows with a cyan perspective grid and a striped magenta-orange sun on a dark field, and the marquee glows warm cream behind a neon logo. Everything is blocky primitives with facet edges; fine detail is small parts in their own flat colours seated on the surfaces.

mounts.bodyTop: the body's top plane at y = 1.02, spanning z -0.45..0.46; the control deck sits on its front zone (z 0.18..0.46) and the screen housing on its rear zone (z -0.45..0.20)
mounts.rearFace: the shared back plane at z = -0.45 (rear skin builds to z -0.47 for thickness)

parts.builds: The lower cabinet body y 0-1.02, a slab box 0.72 wide (x -0.36..0.36) and 0.90 deep (z -0.45..0.45) in cabBody, standing on y = 0. Front face (+Z): a kick plinth strip y 0..0.08 in ink, then the coin door — a recessed steel rectangle ~0.28 wide x 0.30 tall centred at [0, 0.38, 0.452], with two coin-entry slots as small chrome plates, a lock cylinder dot, and a thin neonPink trim frame around the door. Above the door a small chrome manufacturer plate at [0, 0.85, 0.452] (~0.2 x 0.08). Sides (x = +/-0.36): the signature synthwave side art as horizontal sunset bands built as thin proud panels, each a separate flat-coloured part on its own colour: from y 0.55 to 0.95 a stack of sunYellow, sunOrange, sunRed, neonPink bands each ~0.08-0.10 tall and ~0.06 wide proud of the side, reading as a setting sun; below them two thin neonCyan pinstripes y 0.30 and 0.34; all bands inset from the front/back edges so the cabEdge corner posts stay visible. Top: a thin cabEdge trim band around the top perimeter. Back edge closed with a simple cabSide skin at z = -0.45 in this y range (the rear panel part overlaps outside it). All trims and stripes are small parts seated exactly on the slab faces.
parts.attaches: Stands on the floor (floor: true). Its top plane y = 1.02 is the mount bodyTop; the control deck sits on its front zone and the screen housing on its rear zone. Rear skin meets rearFace.

parts.builds: The player-facing control deck: a sloped slab in cabBody from the front lip (z = 0.46, y = 1.05) up to the rear edge (z = 0.18, y = 1.22), 0.80 wide (x -0.40..0.40), with two short side cheeks in cabEdge closing the wedge at each end. The top surface carries the controls: at [0.22, 1.12, 0.34] and [-0.22, 1.12, 0.34] (exactly the joy1 and joy2 joints) a black joystick well ring in panelDark with a chrome shaft (thin rod ~0.09 tall leaning slightly toward the player) topped by a stickBall sphere ~0.035 radius — build the shaft and ball under joint joy1 / joy2 so they can wiggle. In front of each stick a fan of four round buttons ~0.028 diameter in btnRed, btnYellow, btnBlue, btnGreen, seated in a panelDark button deck plate (~0.22 x 0.14) inset into the slope. Between the player positions, a small control-panel artwork insert: a neonPurple rectangle with a tiny neonCyan grid of thin strips and a neonPink sun disc. Around the whole deck lip runs a thin neonCyan edge trim; the rear edge where the deck meets the screen housing gets a neonPink trim strip. Under-deck skirt in cabBody closes the wedge front face y 1.02..1.05.
parts.attaches: Sits on bodyTop (front zone). Its rear/top edge meets the screen housing front bottom at mount deckRearEdge [0, 1.22, 0.18]; front lip overhangs to deckFrontLip [0, 1.05, 0.46]. Joystick shafts and balls ride joints joy1 and joy2; everything else rides cabinet.

parts.builds: The CRT housing y 1.02-1.62, a box 0.72 wide (x -0.36..0.36) spanning z -0.45..0.24 in cabBody, with its own side cheeks in cabSide for this y range carrying a continuation of the sunset band motif: one neonPurple band y 1.15..1.22 and one neonCyan pinstripe y 1.38 on each side. Front face: a chunky bezel frame in cabEdge ~0.09 wide around a screen opening centred at [0, 1.34, 0.22]; inside it the CRT glass, a dark panel in screenDark tilted back ~8 degrees (top edge further back than the bottom), about 0.56 wide x 0.42 tall. On the glass, built as separate glowing parts: a magenta-orange striped setting sun (stacked sunRed / sunOrange / sunYellow horizontal bars of decreasing width, the lowest bar split by two thin screenDark gaps, classic synthwave sun) centred slightly above screen centre, and below it a cyan perspective grid — a horizon line in neonCyan plus 5-6 fan lines converging toward the horizon and 4-5 horizontal lines widening downward, all thin neonCyan strips. glow() the sun bars and grid strips so the screen is self-lit. Add two small chrome screen-corner screws and a thin ink screen shadow line under the bottom bezel. Bottom front of the housing (below the bezel, y 1.02..1.10, z down to 0.22) is a cabBody apron that meets the deck's rear edge.
parts.attaches: Sits on bodyTop (rear zone), sill at screenSill [0, 1.06, 0.22]. Its front lower edge meets the control deck at deckRearEdge; its top plane y = 1.62 is the screenTop mount where the marquee sits. Rear face meets rearFace.

parts.builds: The crown: a marquee lightbox y 1.60-1.80, 0.76 wide (x -0.38..0.38, jutting 0.02 past the housing on each side), z -0.45..0.26, jutting 0.02 forward of the screen housing. Main body in cabBody; the backlit front panel (a recessed rectangle ~0.62 wide x 0.14 tall centred at [0, 1.70, 0.245], in marqueeGlow) glows — pass it through glow() — and carries the logo built as flat parts on its face: a synthwave setting sun half-disc of stacked neonPink / sunRed / sunOrange horizontal bars on the left-centre, two thin neonCyan horizon lines running under it, and a simple game title as chunky geometric letterforms (abstract angular blocks, e.g. three strokes forming a stylised 'N' plus a triangle 'A'-like shape) in ink and neonPurple on the right. Around the lit panel a chrome bezel frame, and along the very top edge a full-width neonPink trim strip plus a thin cabEdge cap slab on top. Sides of the lightbox get one diagonal neonCyan stripe each. The back of the lightbox closes in cabBody down to the housing top.
parts.attaches: Sits on the screen housing top at screenTop [0, 1.62, 0] (its inner walls overlap the housing's top 2 cm). Front face and sides are the model's top silhouette; nothing sits above y = 1.80.

parts.builds: The cabinet's back, seen when walking around the machine: a flat rear skin spanning x -0.36..0.36, y 0.02-1.60 at z -0.40..-0.47 in cabSide, closing behind the body, screen housing and deck. On it: a wide vent grille — a recessed panelDark rectangle ~0.34 x 0.30 centred at [0, 1.30, -0.462] with 6 horizontal chrome louvre slats; a small steel power-switch plate at [0.18, 0.95, -0.462] with a chrome rocker switch and a tiny neonRed indicator dot; a cable exit grommet in ink at [-0.18, 0.35, -0.462]; and one bold synthwave signature: a full-width horizontal neonPurple trim stripe y 1.44 plus a thin neonCyan stripe y 0.55 wrapping the whole back. A small rectangular service hatch in cabBody with a neonPink trim frame sits at [0, 0.62, -0.462]. The skin's top edge at y = 1.60 tucks under the marquee box; its bottom stops 2 cm above the floor.
parts.attaches: Covers the shared rearFace plane; sits behind baseBody (which owns a simple closing skin at z = -0.45 in its y range), the screen housing and the control deck. Top edge meets the marquee's underside; bottom floats 2 cm above the floor.
